publishing_metadata.description:
You waited three hours for their message. But the second your phone buzzes, you reply in three seconds. Why?

You thought it communicated loyalty. You thought it communicated genuine enthusiasm. But what it actually communicated was absolute panic.

In this animated short film, we break down why unconditional availability suffocates attraction, why the human brain devalues whatever comes without effort, and why placing someone above you forces them to look down on you.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⏱️ CHAPTER TIMESTAMPS
00:00 - The Uncomfortable Question ("Why?")
00:08 - The Person Who Replies in 3 Seconds
00:40 - The Detached Mind (Why They Don't Jump)
01:02 - Staring at the Screen at 2:00 AM
01:21 - Evolutionary Calculations of Value
01:45 - The Pedestal Effect (Celebrity vs Fan)
02:17 - Scarcity: Why Free Water Is Never Treasured
02:35 - Chapter 02 Preview: The Casino Effect
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💬 QUESTION FOR THE COMMENTS:
Be honest: Have you ever been the person replying in three seconds flat, or have you been on the other side—pulling away because someone was too available? What did that experience teach you?

🔔 Subscribe to Sticky in Dark for Chapter 02: "The Casino Effect: Protecting Your Value Without Becoming Toxic"
